d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Roberto Winkler is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Roberto kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Roberto's gone." Adrian looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Roberto." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Deborah blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Silver Tongue (Level 1). Words are tools. You've got a whole workshop.

d41: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Roberto Winkler, 41 days. The mantle passes to Deborah Barnes.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Deborah Barnes, 25 — a radio DJ. Her hands know different work now: Iron Stomach.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Roberto — and Roberto is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Adrian, Sanjay, Tsuyoshi and 6 more speak for Deborah — "Roberto trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Deborah before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
